source.title: Frontier Sentinel, 28 September 1946, p. 5 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) R.D.C.")
source.publisher: Frontier Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1946: six contests, 21 unopposed returns, and no nominations for Ballymoyer and Derrymore. The Frontier Sentinel prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. W. Cooke: no party label printed in 1946. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Newtownhamilton, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1939, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections"); Newtownhamilton, 2 June 1949, printed 'Unionist': Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (election nominations)"); Frontier Sentinel, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry and Kilkeel Rural Councils' Nominations")).
